h1.en: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump keeps its own figures; Reynolds number is only the picture
h1.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机保留自己的数字，「雷诺数」只是配图

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 25 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa. Output is a volume rate. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reynolds_number.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油搅拌泵一体机的理论输送量写成25 m³/h，把最大出口压力写成23 MPa。柴油搅拌泵一体机这一页把理论输送量写成25 m³/h，把最大出口压力单独写成23 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reynolds_number。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reynolds_number. The picture shows Reynolds number. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 25 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa. A number in m³/h is a volume rate, and a number in MPa is pressure. Its subject is CAT385 Raupenbagger. Stone Capacity (H / V, ≤ 1 inch) 100 / 300 m.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reynolds_number。画面是Reynolds number。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油搅拌泵一体机的理论输送量写成25 m³/h，把最大出口压力写成23 MPa。行程、冲次和价格在说明文字和这一行目录里都没有。

body.en: Output is a volume rate. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. Stroke length, cycle rate and price are absent from both the caption and this catalogue row. Main-unit weight is 4200 kg.
body.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机这一页把理论输送量写成25 m³/h，把最大出口压力单独写成23 MPa。邢台这一行没有标出保养小时间隔、密封扭矩、出口国家或工程案例。

body.en: Pressure is a separate entry on the same sheet. Stone Capacity (H / V, ≤ 1 inch) 100 / 300 m. The Xingtai row does not list a service interval, a seal torque, an export destination or a job case. Those shown extras are still not a stroke length.
body.zh: 细石输送（水平/垂直） 100 / 300 m。细石输送（水平/垂直） 100 / 300 m。

body.en: On the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump sheet, Theoretical Output is 25 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 23 MPa. Main-unit weight is 4200 kg. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³.
body.zh: 河北品锦机械不把这句说明当成柴油搅拌泵一体机的铭牌。

question.en: What output does the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump sheet list?
question.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机这一页的输送量标出多少？

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 25 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reynolds_number.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是25 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reynolds_number画面里印出的数字。

question.en: What pressure entry is on the same sheet?
question.zh: 同一页的压力格是多少？

answer.en: Max. Outlet Pressure is 23 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reynolds_number.
answer.zh: 最大出口压力是23 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reynolds_number画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. The sheet leaves stroke length, cycle rate and price unprinted. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reynolds_number.
answer.zh: 没有。这一页没有标出行程、冲次和价格。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reynolds_number画面里印出的数字。
